title: Threads, visibility, and shared state — Java Practice
description: Independent practice: Prevent lost updates when two workers count orders. Seven questions with explanations.
author: DailyCoder

options.text: An automatic lock on every object
A wait for a thread to finish, with completion visibility guarantees
A guarantee of execution order between all threads

questions.explanation: A successful join establishes the required completion relationship.

questions.prompt: Which operation safely increments one shared integer?
questions.explanation: The atomic operation prevents lost updates.

questions.prompt: What is one common cause of deadlock?

options.text: Opposing acquisition order for shared locks

questions.explanation: Cyclic lock dependencies can leave threads waiting forever.

questions.prompt: Is every multi-step operation on ConcurrentHashMap automatically atomic?
questions.explanation: Use compute, merge, or another suitable atomic operation for compound updates.

options.text: Confining mutable state to one thread

questions.explanation: Unshared state eliminates cross-thread races on that state.

questions.prompt: How should a translated InterruptedException usually be handled?

options.text: Restore the interrupt flag or propagate the interruption

questions.explanation: Cancellation should remain observable to the caller.
